resources.string: It is signed in as this same device — a backup restored from one into the other. Two apps with one device identity knock each other off the tailnet.
Both use Root Mode with the tailscale0 interface. They share its routes and rules, and each start breaks the other\'s.
It holds the VPN connection, and Android has only one. Starting here takes it away from the other app.
It already listens on the same SOCKS5, HTTP or DNS proxy port, so this start cannot take it. Change the ports in one of them.
